profile.headline: Digital Transformation & Power Platform Leader | SharePoint, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse | Legacy Modernization & Federal Delivery | 20+ Years
profile.jobTitle: Digital Transformation Manager / Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineering Leader and Principal Software Engineer with 20+ years delivering enterprise technology solutions for federal government, higher education, and consulting clients. Deep expertise across the Microsoft Power Platform — Power Apps (Canvas & Model-Driven), Power Automate, Power BI, and Dataverse — and SharePoint, from architecture through migration and modernization. Recognized for transforming underperforming teams, introducing SDLC discipline, and mentoring engineers into high-performing contributors.

Recent work includes architecting a Dataverse-based, model-driven procurement and contracting application from the data model up — including relationships and security roles/teams — and leading SharePoint content migrations using ShareGate. Currently serve as Scrum Master, facilitating Agile ceremonies for a federal modernization program. Other notable innovations: reusable JavaScript libraries that cut development effort by 40%, and a university-wide Academic Appointment Application adopted by thousands of students and faculty.

Core Experience:
•	SharePoint & Power Platform (SharePoint Online, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse)
•	Enterprise Migration & Modernization (ShareGate, legacy workflow/form migration)
•	Full-Stack Development (JavaScript, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, PHP, SQL)
•	Team Leadership & Mentorship (Upskilling, Coaching, SDLC Discipline)
•	Agile Delivery (Scrum Master, Sprint Facilitation, Backlog Management)
•	Governance & Security (Role-Based Access, PowerShell Automation, Compliance)
•	Stakeholder Engagement & Digital Transformation Strategy

Technical Foundation:
•	Architected a Dataverse-based, model-driven procurement and contracting application for a federal agency — designing the data model, relationships, and security roles/teams before development began.
•	Stabilized PBGC's SharePoint team at SAIC by introducing SDLC discipline, upskilling InfoPath users into JavaScript engineers, and delivering a reusable form customization library.
•	Led SharePoint content and site migrations using ShareGate, and modernized 3,000+ legacy workflows and 175+ forms into the Power Platform.
•	Designed and deployed FIU's Academic Appointment Application, a SharePoint-based scheduling system adopted university-wide.
•	Built custom full-stack applications as an independent consultant, including an Order & Workflow Tracker and a Bazi Natal Chart Calculator.
•	Directed SharePoint enterprise projects at Bamboo Solutions/SharePointXperts, sustaining large federal contracts.

positions.title: Digital Transformation Manager / Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Senior SharePoint architect with 20+ years of software development experience, including over a decade owning SharePoint information architecture — site structure, content types, column schemas, and library design — for organizations in highly regulated environments. Builds automated workflows and API-based integrations using Power Automate, and has hands-on development experience with CSOM and the SharePoint REST API. Partners closely with IT, security, and business stakeholders while remaining hands-on technically.

• Own SharePoint information architecture — site structure, content types, column schemas, and library design - for a complex federal environment, applying governance best practices including permission management, security controls, and content retention.
  
• Led migration of 3,000+ legacy SharePoint workflows to Power Automate and 175+ InfoPath/JavaScript solutions to Power Apps, balancing delivery speed with maintainability, governance, security, and user adoption.
  
• Build PowerShell scripts for bulk metadata updates and tenant-wide governance audits, including scripts to crawl all sites in a tenant and retrieve site-level permissions for security review.
  
• Designed and built a model-driven contracting, budgeting, and procurement system with 10-year financial projections, integrating SQL-backed data sources to replace fragmented manual processes.
  
• Architected an agency-wide approval-workflow system with configurable, department-based routing logic, reducing executive approval turnaround by approximately 30%.
  
• Partner closely with business stakeholders, IT, and security teams, gathering requirements and translating engineering concepts into functional language to deliver intuitive, adopted solutions.
  
• Integrate solutions spanning JavaScript, CSOM, SharePoint REST APIs, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Microsoft Graph API with external data sources; use ServiceNow for production incident and operational support.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Databases · Web Application Development · SQL · Front-end Coding · Agile Application Development · Software Development

positions.title: Independent Contractor, Software Engineering
positions.description:
• Built a custom PHP/MySQL Order & Workflow Tracking System with drag-and-drop workflow boards, invoicing automation, and inventory integration with Shopify/Etsy.

• Developed a responsive Bazi Natal Chart Calculator performing 300+ real-time calculations per request via a PHP/MySQL REST API and JavaScript front end.

• Delivered APIs, CMS solutions, and performance optimizations for clients including nonprofits (Jason Kidd Foundation).

• Portfolio: magodevelopment.com

•	Consult, communicate, and collaborate with both functional and technical parties
•	Administer, develop, and optimize databases for department and university-wide administrative systems run in MySQL, Oracle, SharePoint, Access, and flat files
